game: Sword of the Berserk: Guts' Rage
approach: Static SH-4 to C++ recompilation with a native PowerVR2 (Vulkan) renderer, AICA audio and Maple input; no emulator or BIOS.
help: Full story playthrough on both translations
AOT closure past the title screen
notes: Reference release is the JP v1.001 disc (the only one with subtitles). The port boots, skips the startup movies and reaches the main menu, with an added PC OPTIONS page (window mode, render scale, filtering, volume, bindings, English/Castilian menus). HD texture packs and disc-tree mods work. A release AOT build reports 0 untranslated call targets and 0 unmapped accesses, but the scripted boot still stops before the title. A full story playthrough, Steam Deck hardware and macOS remain unvalidated.
